title: Netherlands
author: Artham
rules:
An interesting variation on row and column indexers. With all my appreciation for the Dutch people !

Click here to solve on Sudokupad

Rules

Normal Sudoku rules apply.

Dutch flag : A red cell in column X indicates the column where X appears in the row. A blue cell in row Y indicates the row where Y appears in the column.

Dutch lines : two cells connected by an orange line must have a difference of at least 4.

Digits on a thermometers increase from the bulb on.
